task_description: Build a complete greenfield Java 17 / Spring Boot 3.x software HSM emulator from scratch: Maven project scaffold, core crypto engine (AES-256-GCM, RSA-2048, EC P-256, PBKDF2 master key), PostgreSQL persistence with Flyway migrations, Spring Security token auth (Argon2id), full key lifecycle REST API, cryptographic operations API, hash-chained audit log, user/role management, security hardening tests for all STRIDE threat items, OpenAPI/Swagger docs, GitHub Actions CI, and a comprehensive README. 34 tasks across 9 phases.
